notes: Cyder uses an open cxcompatdb.so loaded by the original CrossOver ntdll hook. It owns current-process CompatDB arguments, DLL overrides, graphics backend validation and runtime prepend; Cyder no longer patches ntdll for CompatDB. The MapleStory stack is D3DMetal-neutral; MoltenVK feature-level validation applies only to the optional DXVK path. Graphics payloads are shipped separately. The release stack includes only the MapleStory adaptive read-ahead cache for read-only WZ files and its 512-slot capacity tuning; ring, summary, timeline, cache-stats, section-map, mmap and prewarm patches remain development diagnostics and are not shipped in the release engine. Dual-variant MoltenVK ships libMoltenVK-1.4.2.dylib and libMoltenVK-1.2.10.dylib with a wait-poll shim as libMoltenVK.dylib and libMoltenVK.real.dylib selecting the active real; 1.4.2 reals keep capability plus present patches (timeline-wait is shim-owned). Native-ddraw-path-v1 captures CYDER_DDRAW_PATH once at PE startup before imports, redirects only bare ddraw names to an absolute native DLL candidate, and preserves Wine native/builtin load-order policy. Private provider configuration is owned by the application and inherited through the normal process environment.
